derivation: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G373 (ἀναπαύω);
def: to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely)

occurrences.text: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
